```{r}
mito <- grep("^MT-", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
bad_genes <- c(cell.cycle, tcr_genes, ig_genes, ribo, mito, hemoglobin, "XIST")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "Path.Stage.bin")
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "Path.Stage.numeric")
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "Path.Stage.numeric", cells.highlight = apc$barcode[apc$Dx == "HC"])

tmp <- as.data.frame(table(apc$pred.monaco))
tmp$pct <- tmp$Freq/sum(tmp$Freq)
keep_cells <- apc$barcode[apc$pred.monaco %in% 
                          tmp$Var1[which(tmp$pct > 0.01 & !is.na(tmp$pct))]]
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "pred.monaco", cells = keep_cells)
tmp <- as.data.frame(table(apc$pred.sca))
tmp$pct <- tmp$Freq/sum(tmp$Freq)
keep_cells <- apc$barcode[apc$pred.sca %in% 
                          tmp$Var1[which(tmp$pct > 0.01 & !is.na(tmp$pct))]]
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "pred.sca", cells = keep_cells)
tmp <- as.data.frame(table(apc$pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l3))
tmp$pct <- tmp$Freq/sum(tmp$Freq)
keep_cells <- apc$barcode[apc$pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l3 %in% 
                          tmp$Var1[which(tmp$pct > 0.01 & !is.na(tmp$pct))]]
DimPlot(apc, group.by = "pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l3", cells = keep_cells)
```

```{r}
df.celltypes <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(asdf$orig.ident, asdf$celltype))

df.celltypes$max.percent <- apply(df.celltypes[, -which(names(df.celltypes) == "total")], 1, max) / df.celltypes$total
df.celltypes$missing <- rowSums(df.celltypes < 5)

hist(df.celltypes$total, breaks = 50)
hist(df.celltypes$max.percent, breaks = 50)
hist(df.celltypes$missing, breaks = 50)
```

```{r}
fibro <- FindVariableFeatures(fibro, nfeatures = 2000)

fibro <- RunPCA(fibro)
fibro <- RunHarmony(fibro, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "RNA", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
fibro <- RunUMAP(fibro, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

fibro <- FindNeighbors(fibro, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
fibro <- FindClusters(fibro, resolution = 0.1)
fibro <- FindClusters(fibro, resolution = 0.3)
fibro <- FindClusters(fibro, resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "celltype")
DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "Tissue")
DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "Dx")
DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")
DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3")
DimPlot(fibro, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5")
```
